relations.note: Robust bipedal frame <- impact absorption <- 1.0g gravity -> Skill 'Heavy Stance' (Defence). Spindly limbs <- low skeletal loading <- 0.38g gravity -> Skill 'Silent Stride' (Control). Weakness: Martians fracture under Earth gravity; Humans tire faster on Mars.

Broadband vocal tract <- mid-frequency acoustic coupling <- 1.0/0.8 bar N2/O2 -> Skill 'Shout' (Control). Both retain identical speech niches despite density shifts, preserving the same communication biome.

High-throughput aerobic engine <- immediate physical exertion <- Earth's 1.0 bar O2 -> Skill 'Endurance' (Defence). Enlarged associative cortices <- neural plasticity <- unified multi-world template -> Skill 'Adapt' (Passive). Metabolic stamina traded for cognitive flexibility.

Low insolation <- energy conservation <- 0.43x solar flux -> Skill 'Trade Ban' (Control). High insolation <- industrial throughput <- 1.0x solar flux -> Skill 'Industrial Surge' (Control). Resource competition fractures the lineage.
